title: CandidateFindingsV1
description: Version 1 of the deterministic telemetry-query connector artifact (TEL-045).

since.description: The inclusive lower bound used for the query.

causalCredit.description: Causal estimates and explicit cannot-identify verdicts for workflow nodes.

attributionCohorts.description: Stored run attribution evidence aggregated by effective version and workload cohort.

faultAudit.description: A bounded, report-only fault-domain audit over enrolled terminal attribution evidence.

promotionSignals.description: All bounded promotion evidence, including ineligible correlational fallbacks.

promotionCandidates.description: Machine-filtered causal signals that are eligible for automated nomination or promotion.

examples.caveat: Eligible only for the observed randomized cohort.

promotionEligible.description: Every item crossing the promotionCandidates boundary is promotion-eligible.

source.description: The promotionCandidates boundary excludes correlational fallback sources.

nomination_guardrails.description: Machine-readable checks required before a credit-assignment finding may become a nomination.

signature.description: The normalized stable finding signature shared by the clustered learning episodes.

classification.description: The governed durable-learning classification for this finding cluster.

recommendedAction.description: The single governed action family allowed to consume this learning cluster.

error_class.description: Normalized error category (e.g. infra, timeout) for an error-signature finding — the other half of the (code, error_class) clustering key that subject alone cannot carry, since two findings can share a code but differ only in error_class.

dedupe_key.description: Stable node and fault-family key used to suppress duplicate nominations.

requires_upstream_cause_check.description: The nominator must reject attribution when journal or repo evidence identifies an upstream cause.

requires_human_review.description: True when deterministic node classification identifies a governing gate, prompt, or workflow.

governing_target_treatment.description: If the target governs its evaluator, require human review and prohibit removing, weakening, or bypassing that evaluator.

runId.description: The run whose journal or artifacts carry the attribution evidence.

stage.description: The stage that emitted the linked evidence.

detail.description: A short explanation of how this evidence supports or rebuts the path attribution.

source.description: The evidence source family, such as journal span or produced artifact.

journalSequence.description: The exact journal event sequence number containing the evidence.

journalPath.description: The repository-relative path to the journal file containing the referenced event.

artifactPath.description: The repository-relative path to the referenced artifact, when the evidence comes from artifact output.

artifactDigest.description: The artifact content digest used to pin the linked evidence exactly.

artifactMediaType.description: The media type of the referenced artifact payload.

nodes.description: The ordered workflow-node path that contributed to the adverse outcome.

share.description: The cohort-normalized share of total adverse attribution assigned to this path.

confidence.description: The aggregated attribution confidence for this path across the cohort.

evidence.description: Concrete journal or artifact links that justify this path's contribution.

effectiveVersion.description: The EffectiveVersion hash segment defining this cohort.

workload.description: The workload identity aggregated within this EffectiveVersion cohort.

runCount.description: The number of runs contributing attribution evidence to this cohort.

topContributingPaths.description: The highest-share attributed paths observed for this cohort.

counterEvidence.description: Concrete evidence that weakens or rebuts the leading attribution paths for this cohort.

faultAudit.description: The deterministic cross-workflow Backprop fault-domain report.

mode.description: Confirms that the audit cannot mutate issues, workflows, or runs.

since.description: The inclusive audit window lower bound.

until.description: The inclusive audit window upper bound.

observationsScanned.description: The bounded number of unique enrolled run observations inspected.

productReliabilityFindings.description: Findings assigned to shared Goobers product or runtime behavior.

externalFindings.description: Findings assigned to a shared harness, model, provider, or environment component.

workflowFindings.description: Findings localized to one workflow definition, version, and node path.

mixedOrUnknownFindings.description: Findings withheld from a single owner because evidence is sparse, mixed, contradictory, or incomplete.

suppressed.description: The number of stable findings omitted by the reporting cooldown.

truncated.description: True when the configured finding budget omitted additional signatures.

faultFinding.description: One deduplicated stable failure signature and its smallest defensible fault domain.

id.description: A deterministic identifier used for deduplication and cooldown tracking.

signature.description: The normalized failure signature shared by the affected runs.

domain.description: The smallest fault domain defensible from the available evidence.

confidence.description: The evidence-derived confidence after sparse, contradictory, and provenance penalties.

runIds.description: The bounded set of affected run identifiers.

nodePaths.description: The distinct attributed node paths carrying this signature.

evidence.description: Exact run, journal, and artifact pointers supporting the finding.

counterEvidence.description: Evidence limitations or contradictions that reduced confidence.

rationale.description: Why the selected domain is the smallest defensible assignment.

alternativeDomains.description: Alternative fault domains and why each was rejected or retained.

recommendedOwner.description: The product area, component owner, workflow owner, or triage lane that should review the finding.

recommendedAction.description: The bounded next action recommended by the read-only auditor.

verification.description: Whether a held-out or post-fix cohort has verified recovery or repetition.

examples.caveat: No trusted randomized assignment or valid comparison cohort.

effect.description: Identified effect, or the retained correlational contrast when promotionSource is correlational-fallback.

lower.description: Lower confidence bound when an interval is available.

upper.description: Upper confidence bound when an interval is available.

identification.description: Identification strategy, or unidentifiable when causal conditions are unmet.

treatedBefore.description: Treated cohort size before the intervention.

treatedAfter.description: Treated cohort size after the intervention.

controlBefore.description: Control cohort size before the intervention.

controlAfter.description: Control cohort size after the intervention.

intervalAvailable.description: Whether the bounds are a promotion-eligible causal confidence interval.

promotionEligible.description: Whether this identified estimate may cross the automated promotion boundary.

promotionSource.description: Identified causal strategy, or correlational-fallback when ineligible.

hasCohortData.description: Whether an experiment actually ran on this node (non-zero cohort counts), distinguishing a genuine identification failure from a node that has never had a versioned changepoint or routed identity recorded at all.

examples.caveat: No trusted randomized assignment or valid comparison cohort.

value.description: Causal effect when eligible, otherwise the preserved correlational fallback value.

lower.description: Lower causal confidence bound for an eligible signal.

upper.description: Upper causal confidence bound for an eligible signal.

caveat.description: Identification caveat that must accompany the signal.

promotionEligible.description: Whether this signal may cross the machine-filtered promotion boundary.

runId.description: The run whose journal contains evidence for this finding.

seq.description: The exact journal event sequence containing the evidence.
